_comment: A new record starts in its lifecycle's initial state, and OpenRegister refuses any other status on create (lifecycle-invalid-initial). These six schemas defaulted status to a later state, so a record created without naming its status (the Add forms, the API) was refused with a 422. Each default now equals its lifecycle's initial state, and each schema version rises so the change deploys. Guarded for every schema by tests/Unit/Settings/LifecycleInitialDefaultTest.php.
